title: 09. Production & Safety: Tool Safety Controls
summary: Tools give agents real power — reading files, executing code, calling APIs, deleting records. This power must be constrained.

sections.title: What Is It?
sections.body: > Tools give agents **real power** — reading files, executing code, calling APIs, deleting records. This power must be constrained. Tool safety controls limit **what tools can do**, **which paths they access**, and **what commands they run**.

sections.title: Tool Safety Explained
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              TOOL SAFETY — LAYERED CONTROLS                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  CONTROL 1: TOOL ALLOWLIST
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Not all users should access all tools.

  Free tier users:    [search, calculator, summarizer]
  Pro tier users:     [search, calculator, summarizer, file_reader]
  Admin users:        [all tools]
  Anonymous users:    [search, calculator] only

  CONTROL 2: PARAMETER VALIDATION
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Every tool parameter must be validated:

  file_reader(path):
  ❌ path = "../../etc/passwd"   → path traversal, BLOCK
  ❌ path = "/root/.ssh/id_rsa"  → sensitive file, BLOCK
  ✅ path = "./data/report.csv"  → allowed directory, OK

  shell_execute(command):
  ❌ command = "rm -rf /"        → destructive, BLOCK
  ❌ command = "curl evil.com"   → network call, BLOCK
  ❌ command = "cat /etc/shadow" → sensitive file, BLOCK
  ✅ command = "ls ./output/"    → safe listing, OK

  CONTROL 3: DESTRUCTIVE ACTION CONFIRMATION
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Before executing irreversible actions:
  → Show exactly what will happen
  → Require explicit human confirmation
  → Log the confirmation

  DELETE operation:
  Agent: "I will delete 1,247 records matching: status='old'
          from table 'users'. This cannot be undone.
          Type 'CONFIRM DELETE' to proceed."
  User: "CONFIRM DELETE"
  Agent: ✅ Executes (and logs confirmation)

  CONTROL 4: SANDBOX EXECUTION
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Code execution must be sandboxed:
  • No file system access (except /tmp)
  • No network calls
  • No process spawning
  • Memory limit: 512MB
  • Time limit: 30 seconds
  • No shell access

  CONTROL 5: OUTPUT FILTERING
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Tool outputs must be filtered before returning to LLM:
  • Strip secrets from file contents
  • Limit output size (no 100MB file dumps)
  • Sanitize HTML from web content
  • Remove injection attempts from web pages
```
